svg.title: ttt-fenwick
svg.desc: Log-linear attention. A 16 by 16 causal mask coloured by Fenwick level: each query row t splits its prefix into power-of-two buckets, one state per bucket. For t = 13 the buckets are tokens 0 to 7 (8 tokens, level 4), 8 to 11 (4, level 3), 12 (1, level 1) and token 13 itself (level 0): 4 states. At t = 2^20 a KV cache holds 1,048,576 records, log-linear at most 22 states, linear attention 1 state.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: ot = Σℓ λt (ℓ) St (ℓ) qt , St (ℓ) = Σs ∈ Bt (ℓ) vs ks ⊤
shade = level ℓ (each weighted by λ)
13 = 1101₂: one bucket per set bit, plus the token itself.
Each new token: merge buckets up to lssb(t), promote one level.
States held at t = 2²⁰ ≈ 1M (per head, per layer)
Reported, 21 layers, 50B tokens, 16K: Wiki ppl Mamba-2 22.44 → 22.11,
